modelReview.summary: The manuscript does not report the PCA results or interpret the components, making the study fundamentally incomplete. Critical methodological and reporting gaps prevent any evaluation of the claimed latent structure.

findings.title: Manuscript does not report PCA outcomes or answer the research question
findings.whyItMatters: Without any results or interpretation, the study is fundamentally incomplete and cannot be evaluated.
findings.actionableFix: Update the manuscript to include the proportion of variance explained, component loadings, and an interpretation of the latent components. Reference the scree plot and discuss component retention.

findings.title: Variables not described
findings.whyItMatters: The reader cannot assess the meaning or quality of the variables, undermining the interpretability of the PCA.
findings.actionableFix: Add variable descriptions: what do scale items 1-3 and severity measure? What are the units, possible ranges, and reliability estimates?

findings.title: No PCA suitability diagnostics reported
findings.whyItMatters: Without checks like KMO, Bartlett's test, or determinant of correlation matrix, it is unclear if PCA is appropriate for these data.
findings.actionableFix: Run and report standard PCA diagnostics (KMO measure of sampling adequacy, Bartlett's test of sphericity, communalities, check for multicollinearity). Include them in the diagnostics file and manuscript.

findings.title: No descriptive statistics or distribution checks
findings.whyItMatters: PCA is affected by outliers, skewness, and variable scaling. Without summary statistics, the plausibility of the input data cannot be assessed.
findings.actionableFix: Provide univariate summary statistics (mean, SD, range, skewness) for each variable. Report any transformations or scaling applied before PCA.

findings.title: Data not available for reproducibility
findings.whyItMatters: The analysis is based on a local dataset that is not shared, making independent verification impossible.
findings.actionableFix: Deposit a de-identified minimal dataset or synthetic data with the analysis artifacts, or clearly state data availability restrictions.

findings.title: Figure QA file is empty
findings.whyItMatters: The scree plot may have quality issues not automatically checked, potentially misleading component selection.
findings.actionableFix: Populate figure-qa.json with checks for axis labels, title, legibility, and verify that the scree plot is correctly referenced in the manuscript.

findings.title: No interpretation of components provided
findings.whyItMatters: The primary output of PCA is the component structure; without interpretation, the research question remains unanswered.
findings.actionableFix: In the discussion, interpret the loadings: PC1 appears to load heavily on the three scale items, suggesting a general factor; PC2 is dominated by severity. Discuss what this implies about the latent structure.

findings.title: Manuscript is overly generic and lacks study-specific content
findings.whyItMatters: Most of the text is boilerplate that does not reflect the specific analysis, reducing clarity and specificity.
findings.actionableFix: Replace generic placeholder text with details tailored to this PCA analysis, including the specific research context and findings.
